title: The Zhou Law Group
description: The Zhou Law Group is one of the largest family law firms in California, specializing in divorce and related family law issues such as child custody, spousal support, and property division. With a team of top-rated divorce lawyers and Certified Family Law Specialists, they provide effective legal solutions to clients, including tech company founders and high asset-holders. The firm operates in the Greater Bay Area and Greater Los Angeles, offering services in multiple languages, including English and Chinese. Their reputation for professionalism and client care has earned them stellar reviews and a strong presence in the family law industry.
